tools.name: get_goal
tools.description: Live goal state, ledger summary, and checkout URLs. Open bounty: third-party human ≥$1 Stripe plus non-owner agent x402 verify ($0.05+ USDC Base). Free — call before verify. See bountyManifestUrl in response.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Live First Dollar Desk prices. Human $1 Stripe checkout; agent unpaid GET/POST /api/agent/verify is HTTP 402 ($0.05 or $1.00 USDC on Base). Self-pay is rejected.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Paid agent verify credit (machine x402/USDC on Base). Unpaid call returns HTTP 402; settle with a non-owner wallet+tx to record a qualifying agentic sale. Operator/owner wallets and self-pay are rejected.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_goal, get_pricing · Private data: verify · Public sink: get_pricing.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_goal, get_pricing · Private data: verify · Public sink: get_pricing

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
